g.title: application_architecture
g.text: Application architecture | local Docker Compose deployment

g.title: browser->frontend
g.text: static app, uploads and API responses

g.title: browser
g.text: Upload image/video, inspect grids and counts, reopen history
React Query: API state and video progress; React Router: pages

g.title: frontend
g.text: Serves the Vite-built HTML, CSS and JavaScript

g.title: video
g.text: Persist queued job, then return HTTP 202
Local worker: decode and sample frames

g.title: read
g.text: Paginated sessions and stored frame results
Resolve public UUID to a permitted media path

g.title: inference
g.text: Verified checkpoint; detector loaded on first use
Class mapping, boxes and confidence scores

g.title: summaries
g.text: Class counts; optional grid counts by box centre

g.title: repositories
g.text: Session and job records; transactional result writes
Bulk result reads; frame and grid summaries
Interrupted video jobs marked failed on startup

g.title: postgres
g.text: No published database port in this stack

g.title: migrate
g.text: Uses the same image as backend

g.title: weights
g.text: Weights are not built into the image

g.title: notes
g.text: Solid lines: calls or storage access. Dashed lines: configuration, hardware or startup work.
React runs in the browser; Node/Vite are build tools, not another runtime service.
The backend has one local video worker and no separate queue service; volumes are storage, not network services.
The image CLI reuses Python services outside this web deployment; evaluation/training run separately.
GitHub Actions tests and builds the project; it does not automatically deploy this local application.
Local demonstration only: no authentication, public TLS endpoint, object tracking or calibrated ground density.
